description:
Invoke function getMicrosoft365CopilotUserCountSummary

TIP: Gets the Microsoft 365 Copilot user count summary over a period (D7/D30/D90/D180). Returns active vs. total enabled counts per Copilot-integrated app. Higher-level than get-copilot-usage-user-detail — gives the top-line adoption number without per-user names. Use for executive reporting / KPI dashboards (% adoption among licensed users).

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

name: get-copilot-user-count-summary
